# Appendix C: what the build takes from AM2_CPU

`AM2_CPU` is Thalion's library as an Amiga executable. The build extracts these pieces into `build/am2cpu_daten.i` and `build/am2cpu_code.i`; nothing of it is in the repository, and `AM2_CPU` is never read at run time. Location is *hunk:offset* in `AM2_CPU` of version 1.20. The *evidence* column is the tool's own note (German for now).

## Code

Thalion's machine code, taken unchanged where it is pure memory code (no blitter, no OS). Where a piece ends in the blitter part, our routine continues (`jmp`). The music player's hardware accesses are rebound to our shadow registers (`MUSIK_SUP.S`). The tool refuses anything else (unnamed relocation, jump out of a piece, hardware address, non-68000 instruction outside the 68020-only pieces).

| Name | Location | Bytes | Called from |
|---|---|---:|---|
| `Fade_colour` | 0:$23332 | 88 | am Aufruf in Set_D3_light_level (moveq #14,d7 / sub.w d0,d7) |
| `Insert_horizon` | 0:$29A42 | 42 | CPU-Fassung hinter 11:$0000 (einziger jsr aus Draw_horizon) |
| `put_dpoly` | 0:$29A6E | 1480 | CPU-Fassung hinter 11:$0886 (jsr aus Draw_faces) |

| `Draw_ceiling` | 0:$2A70A | 772 | jsr Draw_ceiling / jsr Draw_floor in M3_DisUpd |
